question: India can be divided into how many physiographic regions?
solution:
The correct answer is **__6__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Plate, the northern section of the Indo-Australian Plate, **constitutes the Indian subcontinent's continental crust. Natural arrangement distinguishes physical divides.
 
• On the basis of the various physiographic features, India is categorised into six physiographic divisions: Northern and North-eastern Mountain; Northern Plain; Peninsular Plateau; Indian
